title: Knit Shawl Sleeve Sheath Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This shawl-sleeve sheath dress is made for occasions where you want coverage and a clean, tailored look. The draped shawl overlay softens the shoulders and upper arms, while the V-neckline flatters the neckline without feeling too low. A defined waist seam and streamlined sheath skirt create a smooth, put-together silhouette that works for sitting, walking, and photos. The knee-length hem keeps it event-appropriate for wedding guest outfits, mother of the bride or groom looks, church ceremonies, cocktail parties, and formal dinners.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
